title: GKOS v0.81 — A Developmental Pre-standard for AI Governance, Accountability and Auditability
description: The Governed Knowledge Operations Standard (GKOS) is a developmental public pre-standard designed to support AI governance, accountability, and auditability. It defines seven cumulative responsibilities for preserving sources, governing identity and lineage, applying deterministic controls, recording authorized review, assembling purpose-bound context, and recording authorized actions or refusals. Version 0.81 consolidates captured-time authority validity, review lifecycle and protected-disclosure requirements, the eighth documentation-intent invariant, and explicit publication controls. The edition contains 62 permanent requirement allocations and 28 mandatory diagnostic gate codes. This owner-authorized v0.x publication is non-consensus and non-qualifying; it does not establish implementation certification, regulatory approval, or independently demonstrated effectiveness. Public second implementation remains awaiting. Documentation and original graphics are CC BY 4.0; schemas, fixtures, workflows, scripts, and reference code remain Apache-2.0.
notes: Release-level CC BY 4.0 metadata describes the normative standard. Individual implementation artifacts remain Apache-2.0 as declared by LICENSE.md.
